mu_name_from: MuMain loads helm indexes 10 to 14 from HelmElf{i+1} (ZzzOpenData.cpp line 148: `AccessModel(MODEL_HELM + i + 10, ..., L"HelmElf", i + 1)`), so index 11 is HelmElf02, which openmu's 0.75 Armors.cs names the Silk Helm. Group 7 index 11, Player/HelmElf02.bmd.
why_this_one: The Fairy Elf's second set, and the first one she can buy: Elf Lala in Noria carries all five pieces at +2 (src/sim/market.cpp, kElfLala, the index-11 rows). Here so that her shelf shows the pieces it sells rather than their names.
profile_from: Not armour, whose default is plate_steel: nothing in this set is a forged plate. The sheets are violet quilted fabric with gold flourishes painted into it, which is the Pad set's reading - stuffed cloth, not a plate - in the elf's colours. See profiles/soft_armour.json.
keeps_head_from: ZzzCharacter.cpp line 12122, SetCharacterScale: helms MODEL_VINE_HELM to MODEL_SPIRIT_HELM keep BODYPART_HEAD as the class's bare head and draw it under the helm, and helm 11 is inside that range (10 Vine, 11 Silk, 12 Wind, 13 Spirit). The model agrees: one sheet, 42 triangles, no skin sheet, so it carries no face of its own. See HelmElf01's note for the whole rule.

stats.note: The item's own row, copied from OpenMU's 0.75 initialiser rather than restated, with the call it came from beside it.
stats.from: openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/Version075/Items/Armors.cs line 64. The 0.75 table, which is the version this server is being built to.
stats.call_note: ArmorInitializerBase.CreateArmor(number, slot, width, height, name, dropLevel, defense, durability, strengthRequirement, agilityRequirement, darkWizardClassLevel, darkKnightClassLevel, elfClassLevel). `armor.Group = (byte)(slot + 5)`, so slot 2 is group 7, 3 is 8 and 4 is 9.
stats.defense_note: Points of defence, in the row and summed into Player.ArmourDefense by Wear - see shared/Rows.cs.
stats.classes_from: The last three ints of the call are 0, 0, 1 - the Fairy Elf alone. 70 agility beside thirty strength is the row saying the same thing in stats.

sheet_from: Data/Player/head_a02.OZJ (64x64), from MuMain, and it is the only sheet the model names - one mesh, 42 triangles, no hide and no skin. The .bmd names head_a02.jpg.
sheet_note: head_a02 is a violet hood in quilted fabric with two gilt discs painted on it and a dark oval for the face opening. Mean (110, 85, 94) at chroma 42.
material_note: One island, head_a02's 42 triangles, the whole hood. cloth rather than the profile's leather, for the Pad Helm's reason: quilted padding with its ornament painted in, and the two gilt discs are a few texels on an island that is otherwise violet fabric. The island is the unit and majority is not close.
